summary: Amanda thanks for such a thorough review of the episode. I will record Ben next dog podcst he uses. I have thinkalouds of him learning CSS, but thats more like us, try something, break something, try something else. The screen reader for him is using content when he researches dog breeds.

body_html:
Amanda thanks for such a thorough review of the episode. I will record Ben next dog podcst he uses. I have thinkalouds of him learning CSS, but thats more like us, try something, break something, try something else.
